items.heading: Paella
details: Key ingredients: short-grain rice, saffron, chicken, rabbit or seafood, green beans, tomato
Saute meat in a wide paella pan until browned.
Add tomato, saffron-infused stock and rice, spreading it evenly.
Simmer without stirring until the rice absorbs the liquid and a crust forms at the bottom.
Rest briefly before serving straight from the pan.

items.heading: Gazpacho
details: Key ingredients: ripe tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar, bread
Blend tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, garlic and soaked bread until smooth.
Whisk in olive oil and sherry vinegar, then season with salt.
Chill for at least two hours to let the flavors develop.
Serve cold, garnished with diced vegetables and a drizzle of olive oil.

items.heading: Churros con Chocolate
details: Key ingredients: flour, water, butter, sugar, cinnamon, dark chocolate
Bring water, butter and a pinch of salt to a boil, then beat in flour to form a dough.
Pipe strips of dough into hot oil and fry until golden.
Roll the fried churros in cinnamon sugar.
Serve with a cup of thick melted dark chocolate for dipping.
